description: Track working sessions with goals and outcomes. v0.8: optional 'project' arg binds the session to a named project (upserts in brain_projects); subsequent handlers will scope reads/writes to that project.

allow_secret.description: Refused when the text looks like a live credential (token, password, URL with embedded creds). Set true only for a false match — the text is then stored verbatim, in clear, and reachable by search, export and every client.

project.description: v0.8: project name to bind this session to (created on first use). Omit to keep session global.
